conclusion: RAM-only bulk copy gains did not establish lower Kodi CPU or a native playback benefit; both native studies retain one census FAIL. Preserve the prototypes as experiments only.

sources.local_commit_scope: Bulk/NT commits are local identifiers, not published source links. The adjacent .patch preserves the complete production/test delta BASE..NT without applying it.

prototype_scope.bulk: Coalesce each tightly packed NV12 plane; retain stride/crop fallback, neutral padding, zero extents, 32-bit whole-plane overflow guard and CPU ownership.
prototype_scope.non_temporal: On top of bulk, SSE2 DecodedPublic DMA-BUF writes width>=256 use cached prefix, destination-aligned full64B NT lines and cached tail; one SFENCE before unchanged END. Generic, CPU-only and non-SSE keep prior paths.
prototype_scope.native_flags: -O2 -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -fPIC -msse2; same unchanged headers/pkg-config libraries and DIL for all VA builds
prototype_scope.status: No production code/default/ABI/legacy ioctl/external-app change is adopted by these fixtures.

environment.display: Private GPU Weston 14.0.2 headless, source dimensions (1280x720 or 1920x1080), 60 Hz; system display unchanged
environment.audio: Same AAC file/stock Kodi decoder; private nondefault PipeWire null sink, link verified; physical AV NOT RUN

measurement.native: Two separate studies, each ABBA at1080p30 then720p60, same30s synthetic motion+AAC files; pristine Kodi22RC1 original bundled FFmpeg9.0.2. All16 arms executed; PASS-only summaries do not erase the two FAILs.
measurement.Kodi_CPU: /proc process USER+SYS from file invocation through natural close/join and empty active-player list; one core=100%; excludes compositor, observer, background and asynchronous kernel CPU.
measurement.profiler: Read-only entry/return uprobes. Function wall_ns are inclusive elapsed wall, including nested access, blocking/scheduling and instrumentation. They are not exclusive CPU or memcpy-only time; never sum nested timings.
measurement.inlining: Out-of-line Begin/End coverage is incomplete: EndCpuAccess count1 does not measure all END calls. Explicit in-Copy ioctl flags2/6 timing is the separate destination START/END evidence when present.
measurement.scope: Headless GPU rendering and null audio; render return counts are software submissions, not physical displayed frames. Physical A/V, scanout, latency and power NOT RUN in these arms.
measurement.comparison_limits: Two full-census controls per geometry; failed720p60 candidates leave only one valid candidate each. No confidence interval or causal attribution of those failures; no established native improvement.

RAM_micro.method: Exact production CopyNv12Pixels on private CPU vectors with no DMA-BUF fds/device/card/GPU; noinline wrapper and compiler barrier. Allocation/pattern/oracle verification outside timing;32 warmups then1024 calls/sample. CLOCK_PROCESS_CPUTIME_ID; wall measured separately.
RAM_micro.scope: Bulk candidate only; NT micro NOT RUN. Independent logical-pixel/padding oracle and unchanged source checked. RAM CPU gain is not native or physical playback evidence.
RAM_micro.interpretation: FHD tightly packed copy CPU falls26.93–27.52%;720 falls5.33–8.28%. Strided fallback changes sign across batches, so no gain/regression established there.
